name: wisepim
description: Set up WISEPIM, research product facts, enrich and translate content, and prepare catalog improvements with approval in WISEPIM.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your product catalog into the conversation with WISEPIM, the AI-powered product information management (PIM) workspace. Get help creating an account and setting up a first catalog, or connect an existing project. Research product facts with source evidence, enrich descriptions and attributes, translate content, and clean inconsistent data. Inspect supplier documents, images, taxonomy and channel issues. Use available commerce and search analytics to prioritize the products that need attention.

Prepare improvements using your WISEPIM settings and saved prompts, review the selected products and proposed operation in WISEPIM, and follow the actual task through to saved results. Each connection authorizes one project, with explicit permissions for its supported workflows. Consequential changes require approval in WISEPIM. Channel export and publication are not included.
defaultPrompt: Help me create or connect my WISEPIM account and set up my first catalog.
Find products missing key information, then prepare descriptions and German translations for my review.
Research missing facts for products I select and show the evidence before proposing changes.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.2.4 updates the 17 pinned WISEPIM skills and clarifies image assessment and existing-image retrieval. MCP workflows do not generate images, video or audio. Consequential actions remain project-scoped and require approval in WISEPIM.
